segments.cnd23:2.1: Sabbesu bhūtesu nidhāya daṇḍaṃ, aviheṭhayaṃ aññatarampi tesaṃ;
segments.cnd23:4.1: Na puttamiccheyya kuto sahāyaṃ, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. Sabbesūti sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ asesaṃ nissesaṃ pariyādiyanavacanametaṃ – sabbesūti. Te tasanti uttasanti paritasanti bhāsanti santāsaṃ āpajjanti, taṃkāraṇā vuccanti tasā. Te na tasanti na uttasanti na paritasanti na bhāyanti na santāsaṃ āpajjanti, taṃkāraṇā vuccanti thāvarā. Tividhaṃ kāyaduccaritaṃ kāyadaṇḍo, catubbidhaṃ vacīduccaritaṃ vacīdaṇḍo, tividhaṃ manoduccaritaṃ manodaṇḍo. Sabbesu bhūtesu nidhāya daṇḍanti sabbesu bhūtesu daṇḍaṃ nidhāya nidahitvā. Aviheṭhayaṃ aññatarampi tesanti ekamekampi sattaṃ pāṇinā vā leḍḍunā vā daṇḍena vā satthena vā anduyā [aruyā (syā.), adduyā (ka.)] vā rajjuyā vā aviheṭhayanto, sabbepi satte pāṇinā vā leḍḍunā vā daṇḍena vā satthena vā anduyā vā rajjuyā vā aviheṭhayantoti – aviheṭhayaṃ aññatarampi tesaṃ. puttāti cattāro puttā – atrajo putto, khettajo putto, dinnako putto, antevāsiko putto. Sahāyanti sahāyā vuccanti yehi saha āgamanaṃ phāsu, gamanaṃ phāsu, gamanāgamanaṃ phāsu, ṭhānaṃ phāsu, nisajjanaṃ phāsu, sayanaṃ [nipajjanaṃ (syā.)] phāsu, ālapanaṃ phāsu, sallapanaṃ phāsu, ullapanaṃ phāsu, samullapanaṃ phāsu. Na puttamiccheyya kuto sahāyanti puttampi na iccheyya na sādiyeyya na patthayeyya na pihayeyya nābhijappeyya, kuto mittaṃ vā sandiṭṭhaṃ vā sambhattaṃ vā sahāyaṃ vā iccheyya [icchissati (syā.) evamīdisesu padesu anāgatavibhattiyā] sādiyeyya patthayeyya pihayeyya abhijappeyyāti – na puttamiccheyya kuto sahāyaṃ.
segments.cnd23:5.2: Ekoti so paccekasambuddho pabbajjāsaṅkhātena eko, adutiyaṭṭhena eko, taṇhāya pahānaṭṭhena [taṇhāpahānaṭṭhena (syā.) mahāni.191] eko, ekantavītarāgoti eko, ekantavītadosoti eko, ekantavītamohoti eko, ekantanikkilesoti eko, ekāyanamaggaṃ gatoti eko, eko anuttaraṃ paccekasambodhiṃ abhisambuddhoti eko.
segments.cnd23:6.2: So paccekasambuddho sabbaṃ gharāvāsapalibodhaṃ chinditvā puttadārapalibodhaṃ chinditvā ñātipalibodhaṃ chinditvā sannidhipalibodhaṃ chinditvā kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitvā akiñcanabhāvaṃ upagantvā eko carati viharati iriyati vatteti pāleti yapeti yāpetīti –
segments.cnd23:7.2: So evaṃ pabbajito samāno eko araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevati appasaddāni appanigghosāni vijanavātāni manussarāhasseyyakāni paṭisallānasāruppāni.
segments.cnd23:7.3: So eko gacchati, eko tiṭṭhati, eko nisīdati, eko seyyaṃ kappeti, eko gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pavisati, eko abhikkamati, eko paṭikkamati, eko raho nisīdati, eko caṅkamaṃ adhiṭṭhāti, eko carati viharati iriyati vatteti pāleti yapeti yāpetīti –
segments.cnd23:8.1: Kathaṃ so paccekasambuddho taṇhāya pahānaṭṭhena eko?
segments.cnd23:8.2: So evaṃ eko adutiyo appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto mahāpadhānaṃ padahanto māraṃ sasenakaṃ namuciṃ kaṇhaṃ pamattabandhuṃ vidhametvā ca taṇhājāliniṃ visaritaṃ visattikaṃ pajahi vinodesi byantīakāsi anabhāvaṃgamesi.
segments.cnd23:11.1: Evaṃ so paccekasambuddho taṇhāya pahānaṭṭhena eko.
segments.cnd23:12.2: Rāgassa pahīnattā ekantavītarāgoti eko, dosassa pahīnattā ekantavītadosoti eko, mohassa pahīnattā ekantavītamohoti eko, kilesānaṃ pahīnattā ekantanikkilesoti eko.
segments.cnd23:13.1: Kathaṃ so paccekasambuddho ekāyanamaggaṃ gatoti eko?
segments.cnd23:13.2: Ekāyanamaggo vuccati cattāro satipaṭṭhānā, cattāro sammappadhānā, cattāro iddhipādā, pañcindriyāni, pañca balāni, satta bojjhaṅgā ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo.
segments.cnd23:15.1: Evaṃ so paccekasambuddho ekāyanamaggaṃ gatoti eko.
segments.cnd23:16.1: Kathaṃ so paccekasambuddho eko anuttaraṃ paccekasambodhiṃ abhisambuddhoti eko?
segments.cnd23:16.3: Paññā paññindriyaṃ paññābalaṃ dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo vīmaṃsā vipassanā sammādiṭṭhi.
segments.cnd23:16.4: So paccekasambuddho maggapaccekasambuddho ñāṇapaccekasambuddho “sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā”ti bujjhi,
segments.cnd23:16.40: channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca bujjhi,
segments.cnd23:16.41: pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ samudayañca … pe … nissaraṇañca bujjhi,
segments.cnd23:16.42: catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca bujjhi,
segments.cnd23:16.43: “yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman”ti bujjhi.
segments.cnd23:17.1: Atha vā, yaṃ bujjhitabbaṃ anubujjhitabbaṃ paṭibujjhitabbaṃ sambujjhitabbaṃ adhigantabbaṃ phassitabbaṃ sacchikātabbaṃ, sabbaṃ taṃ tena paccekabodhiñāṇena bujjhi anubujjhi paṭibujjhi sambujjhi adhigacchi phassesi sacchākāsīti evaṃ so paccekasambuddho eko anuttaraṃ paccekasambodhiṃ abhisambuddhoti –
segments.cnd23:18.2: iriyāpathacariyā, āyatanacariyā, saticariyā, samādhicariyā, ñāṇacariyā, maggacariyā, patticariyā, lokatthacariyā.
segments.cnd23:18.10: Lokatthacariyāti tathāgatesu arahantesu sammāsambuddhesu padesato paccekasambuddhesu padesato sāvakesu.
segments.cnd23:18.18: lokatthacariyā ca tathāgatānaṃ arahantānaṃ sammāsambuddhānaṃ padesato paccekabuddhānaṃ padesato sāvakānaṃ.
segments.cnd23:20.1: Khaggavisāṇakappoti yathā khaggassa nāma visāṇaṃ ekaṃ hoti adutiyaṃ, evameva so paccekasambuddho takkappo tassadiso tappaṭibhāgo.
segments.cnd23:20.9: evameva so paccekasambuddho tattha takkappo tassadiso tappaṭibhāgo eko adutiyo muttabandhano sammā loke carati viharati iriyati vatteti pāleti yapeti yāpetīti –
segments.cnd23:23.5: Idhekacco passati itthiṃ vā kumāriṃ vā abhirūpaṃ dassanīyaṃ pāsādikaṃ paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgataṃ.
segments.cnd23:23.7: kesā vā sobhanā [sobhaṇā (syā.)] mukhaṃ vā sobhanaṃ akkhī vā sobhanā kaṇṇā vā sobhanā nāsā vā sobhanā oṭṭhā vā sobhanā dantā vā sobhanā mukhaṃ vā sobhanaṃ gīvā vā sobhanā thanā vā sobhanā uraṃ vā sobhanaṃ udaraṃ vā sobhanaṃ kaṭi vā sobhanā ūrū vā sobhanā jaṅghā vā sobhanā hatthā vā sobhanā pādā vā sobhanā aṅguliyo vā sobhanā nakhā vā sobhanāti.
segments.cnd23:23.8: Disvā passitvā abhinandati abhivadati abhipattheti anuppādeti [anussarati (ka.)] anubandhati rāgabandhanaṃ –
segments.cnd23:24.3: “asukasmiṃ nāma gāme vā nigame vā itthī vā kumārī vā abhirūpā dassanīyā pāsādikā paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgatā”ti.
segments.cnd23:24.4: Sutvā suṇitvā abhinandati abhivadati abhipattheti anuppādeti anubandhati rāgabandhanaṃ –
segments.cnd23:25.4: Yāvatā taṇhāsaṅkhātena sīmakataṃ [sīmakataṃ mariyādikataṃ (syā.)] odhikataṃ pariyantikataṃ pariggahitaṃ mamāyitaṃ –
segments.cnd23:25.5: “idaṃ mama, etaṃ mama, ettakaṃ mama, ettāvatā mama”.
segments.cnd23:25.6: Rūpā saddā gandhā rasā phoṭṭhabbā attharaṇā pāvuraṇā dāsidāsā ajeḷakā kukkuṭasūkarā hatthigavāssavaḷavā khettaṃ vatthu hiraññaṃ suvaṇṇaṃ gāmanigamarājadhāniyo raṭṭhañca janapado ca koso ca koṭṭhāgārañca, kevalampi mahāpathaviṃ taṇhāvasena mamāyati, yāvatā aṭṭhasatataṇhāvicaritaṃ –
segments.cnd23:26.2: Vīsativatthukā sakkāyadiṭṭhi, dasavatthukā micchādiṭṭhi, dasavatthukā antaggāhikādiṭṭhi.
segments.cnd23:26.3: Yā evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ diṭṭhigahanaṃ diṭṭhikantāro diṭṭhivisūkāyikaṃ diṭṭhivipphanditaṃ diṭṭhisaṃyojanaṃ gāho paṭiggāho [patiṭṭhāho (ka.)] abhiniveso parāmāso kummaggo micchāpatho micchattaṃ titthāyatanaṃ vipariyāsaggāho viparītaggāho vipallāsaggāho micchāgāho ayāthāvakasmiṃ yāthāvakanti gāho, yāvatā dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhigatāni –
segments.cnd23:27.1: Saṃsaggajātassa bhavanti snehāti dassanasaṃsaggapaccayā ca savanasaṃsaggapaccayā ca taṇhāsneho ca diṭṭhisneho ca bhavanti sambhavanti jāyanti sañjāyanti nibbattanti abhinibbattanti pātubhavantīti –
segments.cnd23:28.6: Dukkhamidaṃ pahotīti idhekacco kāyena duccaritaṃ carati, vācāya duccaritaṃ carati, manasā duccaritaṃ carati, pāṇampi hanati, adinnampi ādiyati, sandhimpi chindati, nillopampi [vilopampi (syā.) passa mahāni.170] harati, ekāgārikampi karoti, paripanthepi tiṭṭhati, paradārampi gacchati, musāpi bhaṇati.
segments.cnd23:28.9: Imassa yaṃ icchasi taṃ daṇḍaṃ paṇehī”ti.
segments.cnd23:28.12: Etaṃ bhayaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ kuto jātaṃ?
segments.cnd23:28.13: Tassa snehapaccayā ca nandipaccayā ca rāgapaccayā ca nandirāgapaccayā ca jātaṃ.
segments.cnd23:29.3: andubandhanena vā rajjubandhanena vā saṅkhalikabandhanena vā vettabandhanena vā latābandhanena vā pakkhepabandhanena vā parikkhepabandhanena vā gāmabandhanena vā nigamabandhanena vā raṭṭhabandhanena vā janapadabandhanena vā, antamaso savacanīyampi karoti –
segments.cnd23:29.6: Etaṃ bhayaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ kuto jātaṃ?
segments.cnd23:29.7: Tassa snehapaccayā ca nandipaccayā ca rāgapaccayā ca nandirāgapaccayā ca jātaṃ.
segments.cnd23:30.3: sataṃ vā sahassaṃ vā satasahassaṃ vā.
segments.cnd23:30.5: Etaṃ bhayaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ kuto jātaṃ?
segments.cnd23:30.6: Tassa snehapaccayā ca nandipaccayā ca rāgapaccayā ca nandirāgapaccayā ca jātaṃ.
segments.cnd23:31.2: Tamenaṃ rājā vividhā kammakāraṇā [vividhāni kammakaraṇāni (ka.)] kārāpeti –
segments.cnd23:31.3: kasāhipi tāḷeti, vettehipi tāḷeti, aḍḍhadaṇḍehipi tāḷeti, hatthampi chindati, pādampi chindati, hatthapādampi chindati, kaṇṇampi chindati, nāsampi chindati, kaṇṇanāsampi chindati, bilaṅgathālikampi karoti, saṅkhamuṇḍikampi karoti, rāhumukhampi karoti, jotimālikampi karoti, hatthapajjotikampi karoti, erakavattikampi [erakavaṭṭikampi (syā. ka.) passa ma. ni.1.169] karoti, cīrakavāsikampi karoti, eṇeyyakampi karoti, baḷisamaṃsikampi karoti, kahāpaṇikampi karoti, khārāpatacchikampi [khārāpaṭicchikampi (ka.)] karoti, palighaparivattikampi karoti, palālapīṭhakampi karoti, tattenapi telena osiñcati, sunakhehipi khādāpeti, jīvantampi sūle uttāseti, asināpi sīsaṃ chindati.
segments.cnd23:31.5: Etaṃ bhayaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ kuto jātaṃ?
segments.cnd23:31.6: Tassa snehapaccayā ca nandipaccayā ca rāgapaccayā ca nandirāgapaccayā ca jātaṃ.
segments.cnd23:32.1: So sakena kammena kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.
segments.cnd23:32.2: Tamenaṃ nirayapālā pañcavidhabandhanaṃ nāma kammakāraṇaṃ karonti [kārenti (syā. ka.) passa ma. ni.3.267]–
segments.cnd23:32.3: tattaṃ ayokhilaṃ hatthe gamenti, tattaṃ ayokhilaṃ dutiye hatthe gamenti, tattaṃ ayokhilaṃ pāde gamenti, tattaṃ ayokhilaṃ dutiye pāde gamenti, tattaṃ ayokhilaṃ majjhe urasmiṃ gamenti.
segments.cnd23:32.4: So tattha dukkhā tibbā [tippā (syā.)] kharā kaṭukā vedanā vedeti;
segments.cnd23:32.5: na ca tāva kālaṃ karoti yāva na taṃ pāpakammaṃ byantīhoti.
segments.cnd23:32.6: Etaṃ bhayaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ kuto jātaṃ?
segments.cnd23:32.7: Tassa snehapaccayā ca nandipaccayā ca rāgapaccayā ca nandirāgapaccayā ca jātaṃ.
segments.cnd23:33.1: Tamenaṃ nirayapālā saṃvesetvā [saṃvesitvā (syā. ka.) passa ma. ni.3.267] kuṭhārīhi [kudhārīhi (syā. ka.)] tacchanti … pe …
segments.cnd23:33.2: tamenaṃ nirayapālā uddhaṃpādaṃ adhosiraṃ gahetvā vāsīhi tacchanti.
segments.cnd23:33.3: Tamenaṃ nirayapālā rathe yojetvā ādittāya pathaviyā sampajjalitāya sajotibhūtāya [sañjotibhūtāya (syā.)] sārentipi paccāsārentipi.
segments.cnd23:33.4: Tamenaṃ nirayapālā mahantaṃ aṅgārapabbataṃ ādittaṃ sampajjalitaṃ sajotibhūtaṃ āropentipi oropentipi.
segments.cnd23:33.5: Tamenaṃ nirayapālā uddhaṃpādaṃ adhosiraṃ gahetvā tattāya lohakumbhiyā pakkhipanti ādittāya sampajjalitāya sajotibhūtāya.
segments.cnd23:33.7: So tattha pheṇuddehakaṃ paccamāno sakimpi uddhaṃ gacchati, sakimpi adho gacchati, sakimpi tiriyaṃ gacchati.
segments.cnd23:33.8: So tattha dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vedeti;
segments.cnd23:33.9: na ca tāva kālaṅkaroti yāva na taṃ pāpakammaṃ byantīhoti.
segments.cnd23:33.10: Etaṃ bhayaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ kuto jātaṃ?
segments.cnd23:33.11: Tassa snehapaccayā ca nandipaccayā ca rāgapaccayā ca nandirāgapaccayā ca jātaṃ.
segments.cnd23:50.1: Etaṃ bhayaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ kuto jātaṃ?
segments.cnd23:50.2: Tassa snehapaccayā ca nandipaccayā ca rāgapaccayā ca nandirāgapaccayā ca jātaṃ.
segments.cnd23:51.1: Yāni ca nerayikāni dukkhāni yāni ca tiracchānayonikāni dukkhāni yāni ca pettivisayikāni dukkhāni yāni ca mānusikāni dukkhāni, tāni kuto jātāni kuto sañjātāni kuto nibbattāni kuto abhinibbattāni kuto pātubhūtāni?
segments.cnd23:51.2: Tassa snehapaccayā ca nandipaccayā ca rāgapaccayā ca nandirāgapaccayā ca bhavanti sambhavanti jāyanti sañjāyanti nibbattanti abhinibbattanti pātubhavantīti –
segments.cnd23:52.6: Ādīnavaṃ snehajaṃ pekkhamānoti taṇhāsneho ca diṭṭhisneho ca ādīnavaṃ snehajaṃ pekkhamāno dakkhamāno olokayamāno nijjhāyamāno upaparikkhamānoti –
segments.cnd23:52.7: ādīnavaṃ snehajaṃ pekkhamāno, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.
segments.cnd23:55.5: Idhekacco duddadaṃ dadāti, duccajaṃ cajati, dukkaraṃ karoti, dukkhamaṃ khamati, guyhamassa ācikkhati, guyhamassa parigūhati [pariguyhati (syā. ka.)], āpadāsu na vijahati, jīvitampissa atthāya pariccattaṃ hoti, khīṇe nātimaññati –
segments.cnd23:56.2: Idha bhikkhu piyo ca hoti manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo ca vattā ca vacanakkhamo ca gambhīrañca kathaṃ kattā, no ca aṭṭhāne niyojeti adhisīle samādapeti, catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ bhāvanānuyoge samādapeti, catunnaṃ sammappadhānānaṃ … pe …
segments.cnd23:57.1: Suhajjā vuccanti yehi saha āgamanaṃ phāsu gamanaṃ phāsu ṭhānaṃ phāsu nisajjanaṃ [nisajjā (ka.)] phāsu sayanaṃ phāsu ālapanaṃ phāsu sallapanaṃ phāsu ullapanaṃ phāsu samullapanaṃ phāsu.
segments.cnd23:57.2: Mitte suhajje anukampamāno hāpeti atthanti mitte ca suhajje ca sandiṭṭhe ca sambhatte ca sahāye ca anukampamāno anupekkhamāno anugaṇhamāno attatthampi paratthampi ubhayatthampi hāpeti, diṭṭhadhammikampi atthaṃ hāpeti, samparāyikampi atthaṃ hāpeti, paramatthampi hāpeti pahāpeti parihāpeti paridhaṃseti parivajjeti [parisajjeti (syā.)] antaradhāpetīti –
segments.cnd23:58.2: attānaṃ vā nīcaṃ ṭhapento paraṃ uccaṃ ṭhapento paṭibaddhacitto hoti, attānaṃ vā uccaṃ ṭhapento paraṃ nīcaṃ ṭhapento paṭibaddhacitto hoti.
segments.cnd23:58.3: Kathaṃ attānaṃ nīcaṃ ṭhapento paraṃ uccaṃ ṭhapento paṭibaddhacitto hoti?
segments.cnd23:58.4: Tumhe me bahūpakārā, ahaṃ tumhe nissāya labhāmi cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ.
segments.cnd23:58.5: Yampi [yepi (ka.) evaṃ cūḷani. khaggavisāṇasuttaniddesa 151] me aññe dātuṃ vā kātuṃ vā maññanti tumhe nissāya tumhe sampassantā.
segments.cnd23:58.6: Yampi me porāṇaṃ mātāpettikaṃ nāmagottaṃ, tampi me antarahitaṃ.
segments.cnd23:58.9: Evaṃ attānaṃ nīcaṃ ṭhapento paraṃ uccaṃ ṭhapento paṭibaddhacitto hoti.
segments.cnd23:59.1: Kathaṃ attānaṃ uccaṃ ṭhapento paraṃ nīcaṃ ṭhapento paṭibaddhacitto hoti?
segments.cnd23:59.2: Ahaṃ tumhākaṃ bahūpakāro, tumhe maṃ āgamma buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gatā, dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gatā, saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gatā, pāṇātipātā paṭiviratā, adinnādānā paṭiviratā, kāmesumicchācārā paṭiviratā, musāvādā paṭiviratā, surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭiviratā;
segments.cnd23:59.3: ahaṃ tumhākaṃ uddesaṃ demi, paripucchaṃ demi, uposathaṃ ācikkhāmi, navakammaṃ adhiṭṭhāmi.
segments.cnd23:59.4: Atha pana tumhe maṃ ujjhitvā [pariccajitvā (syā.)] aññe sakkarotha garuṃ karotha mānetha pūjethāti.
segments.cnd23:59.5: Evaṃ attānaṃ uccaṃ ṭhapento paraṃ nīcaṃ ṭhapento paṭibaddhacitto hotīti –
segments.cnd23:59.6: mitte suhajje anukampamāno, hāpeti atthaṃ paṭibaddhacitto.

segments.cnd23:69.4: Yathā āraññiko [āraññako (syā. ka.)] migo araññe pavane caramāno [araññe vasamāno (syā.)] vissattho gacchati vissattho tiṭṭhati vissattho nisīdati vissattho seyyaṃ kappeti.
segments.cnd23:70.2: “seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, āraññiko migo araññe pavane caramāno vissattho gacchati vissattho tiṭṭhati vissattho nisīdati vissattho seyyaṃ kappeti.
segments.cnd23:70.5: Evameva kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.

segments.cnd23:71.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.cnd23:71.2: Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave,‘bhikkhu andhamakāsi māraṃ, apadaṃ vadhitvā māracakkhuṃ adassanaṃ gato pāpimato’.

segments.cnd23:102.4: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā uppajjanti ye pāpakā akusalā dhammā, sarasaṅkappā saṃññojanīyā [saññojanikā (ka.)], tyassa anto vasanti anvāssavanti pāpakā akusalā dhammāti. “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno sotena saddaṃ sutvā … pe … ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyitvā … pe … jivhāya rasaṃ sāyitvā … pe … kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusitvā … pe … manasā dhammaṃ viññāya uppajjanti ye pāpakā akusalā dhammā sarasaṅkappā saṃyojanīyā, tyassa anto vasanti anvāssavanti pāpakā akusalā dhammāti.
segments.cnd23:103.7: Tena samudācarena samudācaranti naṃ pāpakā akusalā dhammāti.
segments.cnd23:103.9: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sāntevāsiko sācariyako dukkhaṃ na phāsu viharatī”ti.
segments.cnd23:104.2: “tayome, bhikkhave, antarāmalā antarāamittā antarāsapattā antarāvadhakā antarāpaccatthikā.
segments.cnd23:104.4: Lobho, bhikkhave, antarāmalo [antarāmalaṃ (syā. ka.) passa itivu.88] antarāamitto antarāsapatto antarāvadhako antarāpaccatthiko, doso, bhikkhave … pe …
segments.cnd23:104.5: moho, bhikkhave, antarāmalo antarāamitto antarāsapatto antarāvadhako antarāpaccatthiko.
segments.cnd23:104.6: Ime kho, bhikkhave, tayo antarāmalā antarāamittā antarāsapattā antarāvadhakā antarāpaccatthikā”ti.

segments.cnd23:112.6: moho kho, mahārāja, purisassa dhammo ajjhattaṃ uppajjamāno uppajjati ahitāya dukkhāya aphāsuvihārāya.
segments.cnd23:112.7: Ime kho, mahārāja, tayo purisassa dhammā ajjhattaṃ uppajjamānā uppajjanti ahitāya dukkhāya aphāsuvihārāya.
segments.cnd23:116.4: kumārakā dhaṅkamivossajantī”ti [caṅkamivossajjantīti (syā. ka.) passa su. ni.273-274].
segments.cnd23:118.1: Parissayānaṃ sahitāti parissaye sahitā ārādhitā ajjhottharitā pariyāditā paṭinissatāti –
segments.cnd23:119.1: Achambhīti so paccekasambuddho abhīrū acchambhī anutrāsī apalāyī pahīnabhayabheravo vigatalomahaṃso viharatīti –
segments.cnd23:119.2: parissayānaṃ sahitā acchambhī, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.
segments.cnd23:122.1: Dussaṅgahā pabbajitāpi eketi pabbajitāpi idhekacce nissayepi diyyamāne uddesepi diyyamāne paripucchāyapi [paripucchepi (ka.)] diyyamāne cīvarepi diyyamāne pattepi diyyamāne lohathālakepi diyyamāne dhammakaraṇepi [dhammakarakepi (syā.)] diyyamāne parissāvanepi diyyamāne thavikepi diyyamāne upāhanepi diyyamāne kāyabandhanepi diyyamāne na suṇanti na sotaṃ odahanti na aññācittaṃ upaṭṭhapenti, anassavā avacanakarā paṭilomavuttino aññeneva mukhaṃ karontīti –
segments.cnd23:123.1: Atho gahaṭṭhā gharamāvasantāti gahaṭṭhāpi idhekacce hatthimhipi diyyamāne … pe …
segments.cnd23:123.2: rathepi khettepi vatthumhipi hiraññepi suvaṇṇepi diyyamāne gāmepi … pe …
segments.cnd23:123.5: janapadepi diyyamāne na suṇanti na sotaṃ odahanti na aññācittaṃ upaṭṭhapenti, anassavā avacanakarā paṭilomavuttino aññeneva mukhaṃ karontīti –
segments.cnd23:124.1: Appossukko paraputtesu hutvāti attānaṃ ṭhapetvā sabbe imasmiṃ atthe paraputtā.
segments.cnd23:124.2: Tesu paraputtesu appossukko hutvā abyāvaṭo hutvā anapekkho hutvāti –
segments.cnd23:124.3: appossukko paraputtesu hutvā, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.
segments.cnd23:127.1: Oropayitvā gihibyañjanānīti gihibyañjanāni vuccanti kesā ca massū ca mālā ca gandhañca vilepanañca ābharaṇañca pilandhanañca vatthañca pārupanañca veṭhanañca ucchādanaṃ parimaddanaṃ nhāpanaṃ [nahāpanaṃ (syā.)] sambāhanaṃ ādāsaṃ añjanaṃ mālāgandhavilepanaṃ mukhacuṇṇaṃ mukhalepanaṃ hatthabandhaṃ sikhābandhaṃ daṇḍaṃ nāḷikaṃ [nālikaṃ (ka.) passa dī. ni.1.16] khaggaṃ chattaṃ citrupāhanaṃ uṇhīsaṃ maṇiṃ vāḷabījaniṃ odātāni vatthāni dīghadasāni [dīgharassāni (syā.)] iti vā.
segments.cnd23:127.2: Oropayitvā gihibyañjanānīti gihibyañjanāni oropayitvā samoropayitvā nikkhipitvā paṭipassambhayitvāti –
segments.cnd23:128.1: Sañchinnapatto yathā koviḷāroti yathā koviḷārassa pattāni chinnāni sañchinnāni patitāni paripatitāni, evameva tassa paccekasambuddhassa gihibyañjanāni chinnāni sañchinnāni patitānīti –
segments.cnd23:129.2: Vīroti vīriyavāti vīro, pahūti vīro, visavīti vīro, alamattoti vīro, sūroti vīro, vikkanto abhīrū acchambhī anutrāsī apalāyī pahīnabhayabheravoti vīro, vigatalomahaṃsoti vīro.

segments.cnd23:130.4: dhīro [vīro (syā. ka.) passa su. ni.536] tādi pavuccate tathattā.
segments.cnd23:131.1: Gihibandhanāni vuccanti puttā ca bhariyā ca dāsā ca dāsī ca ajeḷakā ca kukkuṭasūkarā ca hatthigavāssavaḷavā ca khettañca vatthu ca hiraññañca suvaṇṇañca gāmanigamarājadhāniyo ca raṭṭhañca janapado ca koso ca koṭṭhāgārañca, yaṃ kiñci rajanīyavatthu.
segments.cnd23:132.1: Chetvāna vīro gihibandhanānīti so paccekasambuddho vīro gihibandhanāni chinditvā samucchinditvā jahitvā vinodetvā byantīkaritvā anabhāvaṃ gametvāti –
segments.cnd23:132.2: chetvāna vīro gihibandhanāni, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.
segments.cnd23:139.4: careyya tenattamano satīmā. Sace labhetha nipakaṃ sahāyanti sace nipakaṃ paṇḍitaṃ paññavantaṃ buddhimantaṃ ñāṇiṃ vibhāviṃ medhāviṃ sahāyaṃ labheyya paṭilabheyya adhigaccheyya vindeyyāti – sace labhetha nipakaṃ saṃhāyaṃ. Sādhuvihārinti paṭhamenapi jhānena sādhuvihāriṃ, dutiyenapi jhānena … tatiyenapi jhānena … catutthenapi jhānena sādhuvihāriṃ, mettāyapi cetovimuttiyā sādhuvihāriṃ, karuṇāyapi … pe … muditāyapi … upekkhāyapi cetovimuttiyā sādhuvihāriṃ, ākāsānañcāyatanasamāpattiyāpi sādhuvihāriṃ, viññāṇañca āyatanasamāpattiyāpi … pe … ākiñcaññāyatanasamāpattiyāpi … pe … nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasamāpattiyāpi sādhuvihāriṃ, nirodhasamāpattiyāpi sādhuvihāriṃ, phalasamāpattiyāpi sādhuvihāriṃ. Dhīranti dhīraṃ paṇḍitaṃ paññavantaṃ buddhimantaṃ ñāṇiṃ vibhāviṃ medhāvinti – saddhiṃ caraṃ sādhuvihāri dhīraṃ. Parissayāti dve parissayā – pākaṭaparissayā ca paṭicchannaparissayā ca … pe … ime vuccanti pākaṭaparissayā … pe … ime vuccanti paṭicchannaparissayā … pe … evampi, tatrāsayāti – parissayā. Abhibhuyya sabbāni parissayānīti sabbe parissaye abhibhuyya abhibhavitvā ajjhottharitvā pariyādiyitvā madditvāti – abhibhuyya sabbāni parissayāni. Careyya tenattamano satīmāti so paccekasambuddho tena nipakena paṇḍitena paññavantena buddhimantena ñāṇinā vibhāvinā medhāvinā sahāyena saddhiṃ attamano tuṭṭhamano haṭṭhamano pahaṭṭhamano udaggamano muditamano careyya vihareyya iriyeyya vatteyya pāleyya yapeyya yāpeyyāti – careyya tenattamano. Satīmāti so paccekasambuddho satimā hoti paramena satinepakkena samannāgato, cirakatampi cirabhāsitampi saritā anussaritāti – careyya tenattamano satīmā. Abhibhuyya sabbāni parissayāni, careyya tenattamano satīmā”ti.
segments.cnd23:141.1: No ce labhetha nipakaṃ sahāyanti no ce nipakaṃ paṇḍitaṃ paññavantaṃ buddhimantaṃ ñāṇiṃ vibhāviṃ medhāviṃ sahāyaṃ labheyya paṭilabheyya adhigaccheyya vindeyyāti –
segments.cnd23:142.6: Dhīranti dhīraṃ paṇḍitaṃ paññavantaṃ buddhimantaṃ ñāṇiṃ vibhāviṃ medhāvinti –
segments.cnd23:143.1: Rājāva raṭṭhaṃ vijitaṃ pahāyāti rājā khattiyo muddhābhisitto vijitasaṅgāmo nihatapaccāmitto laddhādhippāyo paripuṇṇakosakoṭṭhāgāro raṭṭhañca janapadañca kosañca koṭṭhāgārañca pahūtahiraññasuvaṇṇaṃ nagarañca pariccajitvā kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitvā akiñcanabhāvaṃ upagantvā eko carati viharati iriyati vatteti pāleti yapeti yāpeti.
segments.cnd23:143.2: Evaṃ paccekasambuddhopi sabbaṃ gharāvāsapalibodhaṃ chinditvā puttadārapalibodhaṃ chinditvā ñātipalibodhaṃ chinditvā mittāmaccapalibodhaṃ chinditvā kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitvā akiñcanabhāvaṃ upagantvā eko carati viharati iriyati vatteti pāleti yapeti yāpetīti –
segments.cnd23:143.3: rājāva raṭṭhaṃ vijitaṃ pahāya, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.
segments.cnd23:146.2: Addhāti ekaṃsavacanaṃ nissaṃsayavacanaṃ nikkaṅkhavacanaṃ advejjhavacanaṃ adveḷhakavacanaṃ niyogavacanaṃ apaṇṇakavacanaṃ aviraddhavacanaṃ avatthāpanavacanametaṃ –

segments.cnd23:146.8: Addhā pasaṃsāma sahāyasampadanti sahāyasampadaṃ pasaṃsāma thomema kittema vaṇṇemāti –
segments.cnd23:147.1: Seṭṭhā samā sevitabbā sahāyāti seṭṭhā honti sahāyā sīlena samādhinā paññāya vimuttiyā vimuttiñāṇadassanena;

segments.cnd23:148.1: Ete aladdhā anavajjabhojīti atthi puggalo sāvajjabhojī atthi puggalo anavajjabhojīti.
segments.cnd23:148.3: Idhekacco puggalo kuhanāya lapanāya nemittikatāya nippesikatāya lābhena lābhaṃ nijigīsanatāya [nijigiṃsanatāya (syā.)] dārudānena veḷudānena pattadānena pupphadānena phaladānena sinānadānena cuṇṇadānena mattikādānena dantakaṭṭhadānena mukhodakadānena cāṭukamyatāya [pātukamyatāya (syā.) mahāni.159] muggasūpyatāya [muggasūpatāya (syā.)] pāribhaṭyatāya pīṭhamaddikatāya vatthuvijjāya tiracchānavijjāya aṅgavijjāya nakkhattavijjāya dūtagamanena pahiṇagamanena jaṅghapesaniyena vejjakammena navakammena [dūtakammena (syā. ka.) mahāni.159] piṇḍapaṭipiṇḍakena dānānuppadānena, adhammena visamena laddhā labhitvā adhigantvā vinditvā paṭilabhitvā jīvikaṃ [jīvitaṃ (ka.)] kappeti.
segments.cnd23:149.2: Idhekacco puggalo na kuhanāya na lapanāya na nemittikatāya na nippesikatāya na lābhena lābhaṃ nijigīsanatāya na dārudānena na veḷudānena na pattadānena na pupphadānena na phaladānena na sinānadānena na cuṇṇadānena na mattikādānena na dantakaṭṭhadānena na mukhodakadānena na cāṭukamyatāya na muggasūpyatāya na pāribhaṭyatāya na pīṭhamaddikatāya na vatthuvijjāya na tiracchānavijjāya na aṅgavijjāya na nakkhattavijjāya na dūtagamanena na pahiṇagamanena na jaṅghapesaniyena na vejjakammena na navakammena na piṇḍapaṭipiṇḍakena na dānānuppadānena, dhammena samena laddhā labhitvā adhigantvā vinditvā paṭilabhitvā jīvikaṃ kappeti.
segments.cnd23:150.1: Ete aladdhā anavajjabhojīti ete anavajjabhojī aladdhā alabhitvā anadhigantvā avinditvā appaṭilabhitvāti –
segments.cnd23:150.2: ete aladdhā anavajjabhojī, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

segments.cnd23:155.2: Yathā ekasmiṃ hatthe dve nūpurāni [dhuvarāni (syā.)] ghaṭṭenti [ghaṭenti (syā.)];
segments.cnd23:155.3: evameva sattā taṇhāvasena diṭṭhivasena niraye ghaṭṭenti, tiracchānayoniyaṃ ghaṭṭenti, pettivisaye ghaṭṭenti, manussaloke ghaṭṭenti, devaloke ghaṭṭenti, gatiyā gatiṃ upapattiyā upapattiṃ paṭisandhiyā paṭisandhiṃ bhavena bhavaṃ saṃsārena saṃsāraṃ vaṭṭena vaṭṭaṃ ghaṭṭenti saṅghaṭṭenti saṅghaṭṭentā caranti viharanti iriyanti vattenti pālenti yapenti yāpentīti –
segments.cnd23:155.4: saṅghaṭṭayantāni duve bhujasmiṃ, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.
segments.cnd23:158.1: Evaṃ dutīyena sahā mamassāti taṇhādutiyo vā hoti puggaladutiyo vā.
segments.cnd23:158.4: Yassesā taṇhā appahīnā, so vuccati taṇhādutiyo.
segments.cnd23:161.2: Idhekacco na atthahetu [attahetu (syā.)] na kāraṇahetu uddhato avūpasantacitto ekassa vā dutiyo hoti, dvinnaṃ vā tatiyo hoti, tiṇṇaṃ vā catuttho hoti.
segments.cnd23:161.5: rājakathaṃ corakathaṃ mahāmattakathaṃ senākathaṃ bhayakathaṃ yuddhakathaṃ annakathaṃ pānakathaṃ vatthakathaṃ sayanakathaṃ mālākathaṃ gandhakathaṃ ñātikathaṃ yānakathaṃ gāmakathaṃ nigamakathaṃ nagarakathaṃ janapadakathaṃ itthikathaṃ [itthikathaṃ purisakathaṃ (syā. ka.) dī. ni.1.17,201; saṃ. ni.5.1080 passitabbaṃ] sūrakathaṃ visikhākathaṃ kumbhaṭṭhānakathaṃ pubbapetakathaṃ nānattakathaṃ lokakkhāyikaṃ samuddakkhāyikaṃ itibhavābhavakathaṃ katheti.
segments.cnd23:162.1: Vācābhilāpo abhisajjanā vāti vācābhilāpo vuccati bāttiṃsa tiracchānakathā, seyyathidaṃ –
segments.cnd23:163.2: Bhayanti jātibhayaṃ jarābhayaṃ byādhibhayaṃ maraṇabhayaṃ rājabhayaṃ corabhayaṃ aggibhayaṃ udakabhayaṃ attānuvādabhayaṃ parānuvādabhayaṃ daṇḍabhayaṃ duggatibhayaṃ ūmibhayaṃ kumbhilabhayaṃ āvaṭṭabhayaṃ susumārabhayaṃ ājīvakabhayaṃ asilokabhayaṃ parisasārajjabhayaṃ madanabhayaṃ bhayānakaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃso cetaso ubbego utrāso.
segments.cnd23:163.3: Etaṃ bhayaṃ āyatiṃ pekkhamānoti etaṃ bhayaṃ āyatiṃ pekkhamāno dakkhamāno olokayamāno nijjhāyamāno upaparikkhamānoti –
segments.cnd23:163.4: etaṃ bhayaṃ āyatiṃ pekkhamāno, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.
segments.cnd23:166.6: Citrāti nānāvaṇṇā rūpā nānāvaṇṇā saddā nānāvaṇṇā gandhā nānāvaṇṇā rasā nānāvaṇṇā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
segments.cnd23:166.10: Cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā,
segments.cnd23:166.14: kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
segments.cnd23:166.16: Yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, ime pañca kāmaguṇe paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ, idaṃ vuccati kāmasukhaṃ miḷhasukhaṃ [mīḷhasukhaṃ (passa ma. ni.3.328)] puthujjanasukhaṃ anariyasukhaṃ, na sevitabbaṃ na bhāvetabbaṃ na bahulīkātabbaṃ,‘bhāyitabbaṃ etassa sukhassā’ti vadāmī”ti –
segments.cnd23:167.2: nānāvaṇṇehi phoṭṭhabbehi cittaṃ mathenti tosenti pahāsentīti –
segments.cnd23:168.4: Idha, bhikkhave, kulaputto yena sippaṭṭhānena jīvikaṃ kappeti, yadi muddāya yadi gaṇanāya yadi saṅkhānena yadi kasiyā yadi vaṇijjāya yadi gorakkhena yadi issatthena [issaṭṭhena (syā.), issattena (ka.) passa ma. ni.1.167] yadi rājaporisena yadi sippaññatarena, sītassa purakkhato uṇhassa purakkhato ḍaṃsamakasavātātapasarīsapasamphassehi samphassamāno [rissamāno (ma. ni.1.167)] khuppipāsāya mīyamāno;
segments.cnd23:168.5: ayaṃ, bhikkhave, kāmānaṃ ādīnavo sandiṭṭhiko dukkhakkhandho kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kāmādhikaraṇaṃ kāmānameva hetu.
segments.cnd23:169.1: “Tassa ce, bhikkhave, kulaputtassa evaṃ uṭṭhahato ghaṭato vāyamato te bhogā nābhinipphajjanti, so socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷiṃ kandati, sammohaṃ āpajjati –
segments.cnd23:169.2: ‘moghaṃ vata me uṭṭhānaṃ, aphalo vata me vāyāmo’ti.
segments.cnd23:169.3: Ayampi, bhikkhave, kāmānaṃ ādīnavo sandiṭṭhiko dukkhakkhandho kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kāmādhikaraṇaṃ kāmānameva hetu.
segments.cnd23:170.1: “Tassa ce, bhikkhave, kulaputtassa evaṃ uṭṭhahato ghaṭato vāyamato te bhogā abhinipphajjanti, so tesaṃ bhogānaṃ ārakkhādhikaraṇaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ [dukkhadomanassaṃ (syā. ka.)] paṭisaṃvedeti –
segments.cnd23:170.2: ‘kinti me bhoge neva rājāno hareyyuṃ, na corā hareyyuṃ, na aggi ḍaheyya, na udakaṃ vaheyya, na appiyā dāyādā hareyyun’ti.
segments.cnd23:170.3: Tassa evaṃ ārakkhato gopayato te bhoge rājāno vā haranti corā vā haranti aggi vā ḍahati udakaṃ vā vahati appiyā vā dāyādā haranti.
segments.cnd23:170.7: Ayampi, bhikkhave, kāmānaṃ ādīnavo sandiṭṭhiko dukkhakkhandho kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kāmādhikaraṇaṃ kāmānameva hetu.
segments.cnd23:171.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kāmādhikaraṇaṃ kāmānameva hetu rājānopi rājūhi vivadanti, khattiyāpi khattiyehi vivadanti, brāhmaṇāpi brāhmaṇehi vivadanti, gahapatīpi gahapatīhi vivadanti, mātāpi puttena vivadati, puttopi mātarā vivadati, pitāpi puttena vivadati, puttopi pitarā vivadati, bhātāpi bhaginiyā vivadati, bhaginīpi bhātarā vivadati, sahāyopi sahāyena vivadati.
segments.cnd23:171.2: Te tattha kalahaviggahavivādāpannā aññamaññaṃ pāṇīhipi upakkamanti leḍḍūhipi upakkamanti daṇḍehipi upakkamanti satthehipi upakkamanti.
segments.cnd23:171.3: Te tattha maraṇampi nigacchanti maraṇamattampi dukkhaṃ.
segments.cnd23:171.4: Ayampi, bhikkhave, kāmānaṃ ādīnavo sandiṭṭhiko dukkhakkhandho kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kāmādhikaraṇaṃ kāmānameva hetu.
segments.cnd23:172.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kāmādhikaraṇaṃ kāmānameva hetu asicammaṃ gahetvā dhanukalāpaṃ sannayhitvā ubhatobyūḷhaṃ [ubhatoviyūḷhaṃ (syā.) passa ma. ni.1.168] saṅgāmaṃ pakkhandanti, usūsupi khippamānesu sattīsupi khippamānāsu asīsupi vijjotalantesu.
segments.cnd23:172.2: Te tattha usūhipi vijjhanti sattīhipi [sattiyāpi (ma. ni.1.167,178)] vijjhanti asināpi sīsaṃ chindanti.
segments.cnd23:172.3: Te tattha maraṇampi nigacchanti maraṇamattampi dukkhaṃ.
segments.cnd23:172.4: Ayampi, bhikkhave, kāmānaṃ ādīnavo sandiṭṭhiko dukkhakkhandho kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kāmādhikaraṇaṃ kāmānameva hetu.
segments.cnd23:173.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kāmādhikaraṇaṃ kāmānameva hetu asicammaṃ gahetvā dhanukalāpaṃ sannayhitvā addāvalepanā [addhāvalepanā (syā.)] upakāriyo pakkhandanti, usūsupi khippamānesu sattīsupi khippamānāsu, asīsupi vijjotalantesu.
segments.cnd23:173.2: Te tattha usūhipi vijjhanti sattīhipi vijjhanti chakaṇakāyapi [chakaṇaṭiyāpi (syā.), pakkaṭṭhiyā (sī. aṭṭha.) passa ma. ni.1.168] osiñcanti abhivaggenapi omaddanti asināpi sīsaṃ chindanti.
segments.cnd23:173.3: Te tattha maraṇampi nigacchanti maraṇamattampi dukkhaṃ.
segments.cnd23:173.4: Ayampi, bhikkhave, kāmānaṃ ādīnavo sandiṭṭhiko dukkhakkhandho kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kāmādhikaraṇaṃ kāmānameva hetu.
segments.cnd23:174.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kāmādhikaraṇaṃ kāmānameva hetu sandhimpi chindanti nillopampi haranti ekāgārikampi karonti paripanthepi tiṭṭhanti paradārampi gacchanti.
segments.cnd23:174.2: Tamenaṃ rājāno gahetvā vividhā kammakāraṇā kārenti –
segments.cnd23:174.3: kasāhipi tāḷenti, vettehipi tāḷenti, aḍḍhadaṇḍakehipi tāḷenti, hatthampi chindanti … pe … asināpi sīsaṃ chindanti.
segments.cnd23:174.4: Te tattha maraṇampi nigacchanti maraṇamattampi dukkhaṃ.
segments.cnd23:174.5: Ayampi, bhikkhave, kāmānaṃ ādīnavo sandiṭṭhiko dukkhakkhandho kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kāmādhikaraṇaṃ kāmānameva hetu.
segments.cnd23:175.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kāmādhikaraṇaṃ kāmānameva hetu kāyena duccaritaṃ caranti vācāya duccaritaṃ caranti manasā duccaritaṃ caranti.
segments.cnd23:175.2: Te kāyena duccaritaṃ caritvā vācāya duccaritaṃ caritvā manasā duccaritaṃ caritvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti.
segments.cnd23:175.3: Ayampi, bhikkhave, kāmānaṃ ādīnavo samparāyiko dukkhakkhandho kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kāmādhikaraṇaṃ kāmānameva hetu”.
segments.cnd23:176.1: Ādīnavaṃ kāmaguṇesu disvāti kāmaguṇesu ādīnavaṃ disvā passitvā tulayitvā tīrayitvā vibhāvayitvā vibhūtaṃ katvāti –
segments.cnd23:176.2: ādīnavaṃ kāmaguṇesu disvā, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.
segments.cnd23:179.1: Ītī ca gaṇḍo ca upaddavo ca, rogo ca sallañca bhayañca metanti vuttañhetaṃ bhagavatā –
segments.cnd23:179.10: Kasmā ca, bhikkhave, bhayanti kāmānametaṃ adhivacanaṃ?
segments.cnd23:179.11: Yasmā ca kāmarāgarattāyaṃ, bhikkhave, chandarāgavinibaddho [chandarāgavinibandho (syā. ka.) passa a. ni.8.56] diṭṭhadhammikāpi bhayā na parimuccati, samparāyikāpi bhayā na parimuccati, tasmā bhayanti kāmānametaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
segments.cnd23:179.19: Yasmā ca kāmarāgarattāyaṃ, bhikkhave, chandarāgavinibaddho diṭṭhadhammikāpi gabbhā na parimuccati, samparāyikāpi gabbhā na parimuccati, tasmā gabbhoti kāmānametaṃ adhivacanan”ti.
segments.cnd23:181.4: sampajaññaṃ na riccati [na riñcati (syā. ka.) saṃ. ni.4.251].
segments.cnd23:183.1: Ītī ca gaṇḍo ca upaddavo ca,
segments.cnd23:184.1: Etaṃ bhayaṃ kāmaguṇesu disvāti etaṃ bhayaṃ kāmaguṇesu disvā passitvā tulayitvā tīrayitvā vibhāvayitvā vibhūtaṃ katvāti –
segments.cnd23:184.2: etaṃ bhayaṃ kāmaguṇesu disvā, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.
segments.cnd23:187.3: abbhantaradhātuppakopavasena vā sītaṃ hoti bahiddhā utuvasena vā sītaṃ hoti.
segments.cnd23:187.5: abbhantaradhātuppakopavasena vā uṇhaṃ hoti bahiddhā utuvasena vā uṇhaṃ hoti.
segments.cnd23:188.2: Vātāti puratthimā vātā pacchimā vātā uttarā vātā dakkhiṇā vātā sarajā vātā arajā vātā sītā vātā uṇhā vātā parittā vātā adhimattā vātā verambhavātā pakkhavātā supaṇṇavātā tālapaṇṇavātā [tālavaṇḍavātā (ka.) cūḷani. upasīvamāṇavapucchāniddesa 43] vidhūpanavātā.
segments.cnd23:192.7: Kathaṃ so paccekasambuddho āguṃ na karotīti nāgo?
segments.cnd23:192.8: Āgu vuccati pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṃkilesikā ponobhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiyā.
segments.cnd23:194.1: Evaṃ so paccekasambuddho āguṃ na karotīti nāgo.
segments.cnd23:195.1: Kathaṃ so paccekasambuddho na gacchatīti nāgo?
segments.cnd23:195.14: na vaggehi kappehi yāyati nīyati [niyyati (syā. ka.)] vuyhati saṃharīyati.
segments.cnd23:195.15: Evaṃ so paccekasambuddho na gacchatīti nāgo.
segments.cnd23:196.1: Kathaṃ so paccekasambuddho na āgacchatīti nāgo?
segments.cnd23:196.2: Sotāpattimaggena ye kilesā pahīnā te kilese na puneti na pacceti na paccāgacchati,
segments.cnd23:196.5: arahattamaggena ye kilesā pahīnā te kilese na puneti na pacceti na paccāgacchati.
segments.cnd23:196.6: Evaṃ so paccekasambuddho na āgacchatīti nāgo.
segments.cnd23:197.1: Nāgova yūthāni vivajjayitvāti yathā so hatthināgo yūthāni vivajjetvā parivajjetvā abhinivajjetvā ekova araññavanamajjhogāhetvā [araññe vanamajjhassa ajjhogāhetvā (syā.)] carati viharati iriyati vatteti pāleti yapeti yāpeti, paccekasambuddhopi gaṇaṃ vivajjetvā parivajjetvā abhivajjetvā eko [eko care khaggavisāṇakappo (syā.)] araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevati appasaddāni appanigghosāni vijanavātāni manussarāhasseyyakāni paṭisallānasāruppāni.
segments.cnd23:197.2: So eko gacchati eko tiṭṭhati eko nisīdati eko seyyaṃ kappeti eko gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pavisati eko paṭikkamati eko raho nisīdati eko caṅkamaṃ adhiṭṭhāti eko carati viharati iriyati vatteti pāleti yapeti yāpetīti –
segments.cnd23:198.1: Sañjātakhandho padumī uḷāroti yathā so hatthināgo sañjātakkhandho sattaratano vā hoti aṭṭharatano vā, paccekasambuddhopi sañjātakkhandho asekkhena sīlakkhandhena asekkhena samādhikkhandhena asekkhena paññākkhandhena asekkhena vimuttikkhandhena asekkhena vimuttiñāṇadassanakkhandhena.
segments.cnd23:198.2: Yathā so hatthināgo padumī, paccekasambuddhopi sattahi bojjhaṅgapupphehi padumī, satisambojjhaṅgapupphena dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgapupphena vīriyasambojjhaṅgapupphena pītisambojjhaṅgapupphena, pītisambojjhaṅgapupphena passaddhisambojjhaṅgapupphena samādhisambojjhaṅgapupphena upekkhāsambojjhaṅgapupphena.
segments.cnd23:198.3: Yathā so hatthināgo uḷāro thāmena balena javena sūrena, paccekasambuddhopi uḷāro sīlena samādhinā paññāya vimuttiyā vimuttiñāṇadassanenāti –
segments.cnd23:199.1: Yathābhirantaṃ vihare araññeti yathā so hatthināgo yathābhirantaṃ araññe viharati, paccekasambuddhopi yathābhirantaṃ araññe viharati.
segments.cnd23:199.16: yathābhirantaṃ vihare araññe, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.
segments.cnd23:202.1: Aṭṭhānataṃ saṅgaṇikāratassa, yaṃ phassaye sāmayikaṃ vimuttinti vuttañhetaṃ bhagavatā –
segments.cnd23:202.2: “yāvatānanda [so vatānanda (ma. ni.3.186)], bhikkhu saṅgaṇikārāmo saṅgaṇikarato saṅgaṇikārāmataṃ anuyutto, gaṇārāmo gaṇarato gaṇasammudito (gaṇārāmataṃ anuyutto)[() natthi ma. ni.3.186], yaṃ taṃ nekkhammasukhaṃ pavivekasukhaṃ upasamasukhaṃ sambodhisukhaṃ, tassa sukhassa nikāmalābhī bhavissati akicchalābhī akasiralābhīti –
segments.cnd23:202.4: Yo ca kho so, ānanda, bhikkhu eko gaṇasmā vūpakaṭṭho viharati, tassetaṃ bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ.
segments.cnd23:202.5: Yaṃ taṃ nekkhammasukhaṃ pavivekasukhaṃ upasamasukhaṃ sambodhisukhaṃ, tassa sukhassa nikāmalābhī bhavissati akicchalābhī akasiralābhīti –
segments.cnd23:202.7: Yāvatānanda, bhikkhu saṅgaṇikārāmo saṅgaṇikarato saṅgaṇikārāmataṃ anuyutto, gaṇārāmo gaṇarato gaṇasammudito (gaṇārāmataṃ anuyutto,) sāmāyikaṃ [sāmayikaṃ (syā. ka.)] vā kantaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharissati, asāmāyikaṃ vā akuppanti –
segments.cnd23:202.9: Yo ca kho so, ānanda, bhikkhu eko gaṇasmā vūpakaṭṭho viharati, tassetaṃ bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ sāmāyikaṃ vā kantaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharissati, asāmāyikaṃ vā akuppanti, ṭhānametaṃ vijjatī”ti –
segments.cnd23:202.10: aṭṭhānataṃ saṅgaṇikāratassa, yaṃ phassaye sāmayikaṃ vimuttiṃ.
segments.cnd23:203.4: So paccekasambuddho sūriyassa gottañātako gottabandhu, tasmā paccekasambuddho ādiccabandhu.
segments.cnd23:203.5: Ādiccabandhussa vaco nisammāti ādiccabandhussa vacanaṃ byappathaṃ desanaṃ anusāsanaṃ anusiṭṭhaṃ sutvā suṇitvā uggahetvā upadhārayitvā upalakkhayitvāti –
segments.cnd23:203.6: ādiccabandhussa vaco nisamma, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.
segments.cnd23:208.1: Uppannañāṇomhi anaññaneyyo, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. Diṭṭhivisūkāni upātivattoti diṭṭhivisūkāni vuccanti vīsativatthukā sakkāyadiṭṭhī. Idha assutavā puthujjano ariyānaṃ adassāvī ariyadhammassa akovido ariyadhamme avinīto sappurisānaṃ adassāvī sappurisadhammassa akovido sappurisadhamme avinīto rūpaṃ attato samanupassati rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ attani vā rūpaṃ rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ, vedanaṃ … pe … saññaṃ … saṅkhāre … viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ attani vā viññāṇaṃ viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ. Yā evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ diṭṭhigahanaṃ diṭṭhikantāro diṭṭhivisūkāyikaṃ diṭṭhivipphanditaṃ diṭṭhisaṃyojanaṃ gāho paṭiggāho abhiniveso parāmāso kummaggo micchāpatho micchattaṃ titthāyatanaṃ vipariyesaggāho viparītaggāho vipallāsaggāho micchāgāho, ayāthāvakasmiṃ yāthāvakanti gāho, yāvatā dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhigatāni – imāni diṭṭhivisūkāni. Diṭṭhivisūkāni upātivattoti diṭṭhivisūkāni upātivatto atikkanto samatikkanto vītivattoti – diṭṭhīvisūkāni upātivatto. ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo, seyyathidaṃ – sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi. Catūhi ariyamaggehi samannāgato niyāmaṃ patto sampatto adhigato phassito sacchikatoti – patto niyāmaṃ. Paṭiladdhamaggoti laddhamaggo paṭiladdhamaggo adhigatamaggo phassitamaggo sacchikatamaggoti – patto niyāmaṃ paṭiladdhamaggo. Uppannañāṇomhi anaññaneyyoti tassa paccekasambuddhassa ñāṇaṃ uppannaṃ samuppannaṃ nibbattaṃ abhinibbattaṃ pātubhūtaṃ. “Sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā”ti ñāṇaṃ uppannaṃ samuppannaṃ nibbattaṃ abhinibbattaṃ pātubhūtaṃ,“sabbe saṅkhārā dukkhā”ti … pe …“sabbe dhammā anattā”ti …“yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman”ti ñāṇaṃ uppannaṃ samuppannaṃ nibbattaṃ abhinibbattaṃ pātubhūtanti – uppannañāṇomhi. Na parappattiyo na parappaccayo na parapaṭibaddhagū, yathābhūtaṃ [taṃ (ka.)] jānāti passati asammūḷho sampajāno paṭissato. “Sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā”ti na paraneyyo na parappattiyo na parappaccayo na parapaṭibaddhagū, yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati asammūḷho sampajāno paṭissato. “Sabbe saṅkhārā dukkhā”ti … pe …“sabbe dhammā anattā”ti … pe …“yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman”ti na paraneyyo na parappattiyo na parappaccayo na parapaṭibaddhagū, yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati asammūḷho sampajāno paṭissatoti – uppannañāṇomhi anaññaneyyo, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.
segments.cnd23:211.2: Yo rāgo sārāgo … pe … abhijjhā lobho akusalamūlaṃ.
segments.cnd23:211.3: Sā loluppā taṇhā tassa paccekasambuddhassa pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
segments.cnd23:212.2: paccayapaṭisevanasaṅkhātaṃ kuhanavatthu, iriyāpathasaṅkhātaṃ kuhanavatthu, sāmantajappanasaṅkhātaṃ kuhanavatthu.
segments.cnd23:213.2: Idha gahapatikā bhikkhuṃ [bhikkhū (ka.) mahāni.87] nimantenti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārehi, so pāpiccho icchāpakato atthiko cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ bhiyyokamyataṃ upādāya cīvaraṃ paccakkhāti, piṇḍapātaṃ paccakkhāti, senāsanaṃ paccakkhāti, gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ paccakkhāti.
segments.cnd23:213.5: Etaṃ sāruppaṃ yaṃ samaṇo susānā vā saṅkārakūṭā vā pāpaṇikā vā nantakāni uccinitvā saṅghāṭikaṃ karitvā dhāreyya.
segments.cnd23:213.7: Etaṃ sāruppaṃ yaṃ samaṇo uñchācariyāya piṇḍiyālopena jīvikaṃ kappeyya.
segments.cnd23:213.9: Etaṃ sāruppaṃ yaṃ samaṇo rukkhamūliko vā assa sosāniko vā abbhokāsiko vā.
segments.cnd23:213.11: Etaṃ sāruppaṃ yaṃ samaṇo pūtimuttena vā haritakīkhaṇḍena vā osadhaṃ kareyyā”ti.
segments.cnd23:213.12: Tadupādāya lūkhaṃ cīvaraṃ dhāreti lūkhaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhuñjati lūkhaṃ senāsanaṃ paṭisevati lūkhaṃ gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ paṭisevati.
segments.cnd23:213.14: “ayaṃ samaṇo appiccho santuṭṭho pavivitto asaṃsaṭṭho āraddhavīriyo dhutavādo”ti.
segments.cnd23:213.17: “tiṇṇaṃ sammukhībhāvā saddho kulaputto bahuṃ puññaṃ pasavati, saddhāya sammukhībhāvā saddho kulaputto bahuṃ puññaṃ pasavati, deyyadhammassa sammukhībhāvā saddho kulaputto bahuṃ puññaṃ pasavati, dakkhiṇeyyānaṃ sammukhībhāvā saddho kulaputto bahuṃ puññaṃ pasavati.
segments.cnd23:213.18: Tumhākañcevāyaṃ saddhā atthi, deyyadhammo ca saṃvijjati, ahañca paṭiggāhako.
segments.cnd23:213.19: Sacehaṃ na paṭiggahessāmi, evaṃ tumhe puññena paribāhirā bhavissatha [bhavissanti (mahāni.87)].
segments.cnd23:213.22: Tadupādāya bahumpi cīvaraṃ paṭiggaṇhāti, bahumpi piṇḍapātaṃ paṭiggaṇhāti, bahumpi senāsanaṃ paṭiggaṇhāti, bahumpi gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ paṭiggaṇhāti.
segments.cnd23:213.23: Yā evarūpā bhākuṭikā bhākuṭiyaṃ kuhanā kuhāyanā kuhitattaṃ –
segments.cnd23:214.2: Idhekacco pāpiccho icchāpakato sambhāvanādhippāyo “evaṃ maṃ jano sambhāvessatī”ti gamanaṃ saṇṭhapeti ṭhānaṃ saṇṭhapeti nisajjaṃ [nisajjanaṃ (ka.)] saṇṭhapeti sayanaṃ saṇṭhapeti, paṇidhāya gacchati paṇidhāya tiṭṭhati paṇidhāya nisīdati paṇidhāya seyyaṃ kappeti samāhito viya gacchati samāhito viya tiṭṭhati samāhito viya nisīdati samāhito viya seyyaṃ kappeti, āpāthakajjhāyīva [āpātakajjhāyī ca (ka.)] hoti.
segments.cnd23:214.3: Yā evarūpā iriyāpathassa āṭhapanā ṭhapanā saṇṭhapanā bhākuṭikā bhākuṭiyaṃ kuhanā kuhāyanā kuhitattaṃ [kuhāyitattaṃ (syā. ka.), visuddhimaggaṭṭhakathā oloketabbā]–
segments.cnd23:215.2: Idhekacco pāpiccho icchāpakato sambhāvanādhippāyo “evaṃ maṃ jano sambhāvessatī”ti ariyadhamme sannissitavācaṃ bhāsati.
segments.cnd23:215.3: “Yo evarūpaṃ cīvaraṃ dhāreti so samaṇo mahesakkho”ti bhaṇati;

segments.cnd23:259.2: Yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya na paṭipajjati, na rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriye na saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
segments.cnd23:260.1: Yathā vā paneke bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saddhādeyyāni bhojanāni bhuñjitvā te evarūpaṃ visūkadassanaṃ anuyuttā viharanti, seyyathidaṃ –
segments.cnd23:260.2: naccaṃ gītaṃ vāditaṃ pekkhaṃ akkhānaṃ pāṇissaraṃ vetāḷaṃ kumbhathūṇaṃ sobhanakaṃ [sobhanagarakaṃ (syā.), sobhanakaraṇaṃ (ka.)] caṇḍālaṃ vaṃsaṃ dhovanaṃ hatthiyuddhaṃ assayuddhaṃ mahiṃsayuddhaṃ [mahisayuddhaṃ (syā.)] usabhayuddhaṃ ajayuddhaṃ meṇḍayuddhaṃ kukkuṭayuddhaṃ vaṭṭakayuddhaṃ daṇḍayuddhaṃ muṭṭhiyuddhaṃ nibbuddhaṃ uyyodhikaṃ balaggaṃ senābyūhaṃ anīkadassanaṃ iti vā.
segments.cnd23:261.2: Idhekacco bhikkhu na cakkhulolo na cakkhuloliyena samannāgato hoti.
segments.cnd23:261.4: na ārāmena ārāmaṃ na uyyānena uyyānaṃ na gāmena gāmaṃ na nigamena nigamaṃ na nagarena nagaraṃ na raṭṭhena raṭṭhaṃ na janapadena janapadaṃ dīghacārikaṃ anavaṭṭhitacārikaṃ anuyutto hoti rūpadassanāya.
segments.cnd23:262.1: Atha vā, bhikkhu antaragharaṃ paviṭṭho vīthiṃ paṭipanno saṃvuto gacchati.
segments.cnd23:262.2: Na hatthiṃ olokento na assaṃ olokento na rathaṃ olokento na pattiṃ olokento na kumārake olokento na kumārikāyo olokento na itthiyo olokento na purise olokento na antarāpaṇaṃ olokento na gharamukhāni olokento na uddhaṃ olokento na adho olokento na disāvidisaṃ vipekkhamāno gacchati.
segments.cnd23:263.1: Atha vā, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī.
segments.cnd23:263.2: Yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
segments.cnd23:264.1: Yathā vā paneke bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saddhādeyyāni bhojanāni bhuñjitvā te evarūpaṃ visūkadassanaṃ anuyuttā viharanti, seyyathidaṃ –
segments.cnd23:264.2: naccaṃ gītaṃ vāditaṃ … pe … anīkadassanaṃ iti vā.
segments.cnd23:265.2: Idhekacco bhikkhu pādalolo pādaloliyena samannāgato hoti –
segments.cnd23:265.3: ārāmena ārāmaṃ uyyānena uyyānaṃ gāmena gāmaṃ nigamena nigamaṃ nagarena nagaraṃ raṭṭhena raṭṭhaṃ janapadena janapadaṃ dīghacārikaṃ anavaṭṭhitacārikaṃ anuyutto hoti.
segments.cnd23:266.1: Atha vā, bhikkhu antosaṅghārāme [antopi saṃghārāme (ka.)] pādalolo pādaloliyena samannāgato hoti, na atthahetu na kāraṇahetu uddhato avūpasantacitto pariveṇato pariveṇaṃ gacchati, vihārato vihāraṃ gacchati, aḍḍhayogato aḍḍhayogaṃ gacchati, pāsādato pāsādaṃ gacchati, hammiyato hammiyaṃ gacchati, guhato guhaṃ gacchati, leṇato leṇaṃ gacchati, kuṭiyā kuṭiṃ gacchati, kūṭāgārato kūṭāgāraṃ gacchati, aṭṭato aṭṭaṃ gacchati, māḷato māḷaṃ gacchati, uddaṇḍato uddaṇḍaṃ gacchati [uddaṇḍaṃ gacchati, uddhositato uddhositaṃ gacchati (syā.) passa mahāni.17], upaṭṭhānasālato upaṭṭhānasālaṃ gacchati, maṇḍapato maṇḍapaṃ gacchati, rukkhamūlato rukkhamūlaṃ gacchati, yattha vā pana bhikkhū nisīdanti vā gacchanti vā, tattha ekassa vā dutiyo hoti, dvinnaṃ vā tatiyo hoti, tiṇṇaṃ vā catuttho hoti.
segments.cnd23:267.1: Na ca pādaloloti so paccekasambuddho pādaloliyā ārato virato paṭivirato nikkhanto nissaṭo vippamutto visaññutto vimariyādikatena cetasā paṭisallānārāmo hoti paṭisallānarato ajjhattaṃ cetosamathamanuyutto anirākatajjhāno vipassanāya samannāgato brūhetā suññāgāraṃ jhāyī jhānarato ekattamanuyutto sadatthagarukoti –
segments.cnd23:268.2: Guttindriyoti so paccekasambuddho cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī.
segments.cnd23:268.3: Yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
segments.cnd23:268.8: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī.
segments.cnd23:268.9: Yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati manindriyaṃ, manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjatīti –
segments.cnd23:269.2: “avassutapariyāyañca [passa saṃ. ni.4.243] vo, āvuso, desessāmi anavassutapariyāyañca.
segments.cnd23:269.4: “Evamāvuso”ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa paccassosuṃ.
segments.cnd23:270.2: Idhāvuso, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe adhimuccati, appiyarūpe rūpe byāpajjati, anupaṭṭhitakāyassati [anupaṭṭhitakāyasati (syā. ka.)] ca viharati parittacetaso.
segments.cnd23:270.3: Tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, yatthassa [tattha ye (ka.) passa saṃ. ni.4.243] te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti.
segments.cnd23:270.5: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya piyarūpe dhamme adhimuccati, appiyarūpe dhamme byāpajjati, anupaṭṭhitakāyassati ca viharati parittacetaso.
segments.cnd23:270.6: Tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti.
segments.cnd23:270.7: Ayaṃ vuccatāvuso, bhikkhu avassuto cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu … pe …
segments.cnd23:270.9: Evaṃvihāriṃ cāvuso, bhikkhuṃ cakkhuto cepi naṃ māro upasaṅkamati, labhetheva [labhateva (syā. ka.) evamuparipi] māro otāraṃ labhetha [labhati (syā. ka.) evamuparipi] māro ārammaṇaṃ,
segments.cnd23:270.11: manato cepi naṃ māro upasaṅkamati, labhetheva māro otāraṃ labhetha māro ārammaṇaṃ.
segments.cnd23:271.1: “Seyyathāpi, āvuso, naḷāgāraṃ vā tiṇāgāraṃ vā sukkhaṃ koḷāpaṃ [kolāpaṃ (syā.) saṃ. ni.4.243] terovassikaṃ.
segments.cnd23:271.2: Puratthimāya cepi naṃ disāya puriso ādittāya tiṇukkāya upasaṅkameyya, labhetheva aggi otāraṃ labhetha aggi ārammaṇaṃ;
segments.cnd23:271.8: yato kutoci cepi naṃ puriso ādittāya tiṇukkāya upasaṅkameyya, labhetheva aggi otāraṃ labhetha aggi ārammaṇaṃ.
segments.cnd23:271.9: Evameva kho, āvuso, evaṃvihāriṃ bhikkhuṃ cakkhuto cepi naṃ māro upasaṅkamati, labhetheva māro otāraṃ labhetha māro ārammaṇaṃ,
segments.cnd23:271.11: manato cepi naṃ māro upasaṅkamati, labhetheva māro otāraṃ labhetha māro ārammaṇaṃ.
segments.cnd23:272.1: “Evaṃvihāriṃ cāvuso, bhikkhuṃ rūpā adhibhaṃsu [abhibhaviṃsu (syā.), abhibhaṃsu (ka.) evamuparipi], na bhikkhu rūpe adhibhosi;
segments.cnd23:272.2: saddā bhikkhuṃ adhibhaṃsu, na bhikkhu sadde adhibhosi;
segments.cnd23:272.3: gandhā bhikkhuṃ adhibhaṃsu, na bhikkhu gandhe adhibhosi;
segments.cnd23:272.4: rasā bhikkhuṃ adhibhaṃsu, na bhikkhu rase adhibhosi;
segments.cnd23:272.5: phoṭṭhabbā bhikkhuṃ adhibhaṃsu, na bhikkhu phoṭṭhabbe adhibhosi;
segments.cnd23:272.6: dhammā bhikkhuṃ adhibhaṃsu, na bhikkhu dhamme adhibhosi.
segments.cnd23:272.7: Ayaṃ vuccatāvuso, bhikkhu rūpādhibhūto saddādhibhūto gandhādhibhūto rasādhibhūto phoṭṭhabbādhibhūto dhammādhibhūto adhibhū anadhibhūto adhibhaṃsu naṃ pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṃkilesikā ponobhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiyā.
segments.cnd23:273.2: Idhāvuso, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe nādhimuccati, appiyarūpe rūpe na byāpajjati, upaṭṭhitakāyassati ca viharati appamāṇacetaso.
segments.cnd23:273.3: Tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti;
segments.cnd23:273.5: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya piyarūpe dhamme nādhimuccati, appiyarūpe dhamme na byāpajjati, upaṭṭhitakāyassati ca viharati appamāṇacetaso.
segments.cnd23:273.6: Tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti.
segments.cnd23:273.7: Ayaṃ vuccatāvuso, bhikkhu anavassuto cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu … pe …
segments.cnd23:273.9: Evaṃvihāriṃ cāvuso, bhikkhuṃ cakkhuto cepi naṃ māro upasaṅkamati, neva labhetha māro otāraṃ, na labhetha māro ārammaṇaṃ;
segments.cnd23:273.11: manato cepi naṃ māro upasaṅkamati, neva labhetha māro otāraṃ, na labhetha māro ārammaṇaṃ.
segments.cnd23:274.1: “Seyyathāpi, āvuso, kūṭāgārā vā kūṭāgārasālā [santhāgārasālā (syā.) passa saṃ. ni.4.243] vā bahalamattikā addāvalepanā [allāvalepanā (syā.)] puratthimāya cepi naṃ disāya puriso ādittāya tiṇukkāya upasaṅkameyya, neva labhetha aggi otāraṃ, na labhetha aggi ārammaṇaṃ;
segments.cnd23:274.7: yato kutoci cepi naṃ puriso ādittāya tiṇukkāya upasaṅkameyya, neva labhetha aggi otāraṃ na labhetha aggi ārammaṇaṃ.
segments.cnd23:274.8: Evameva kho, āvuso, evaṃvihāriṃ bhikkhuṃ cakkhuto cepi naṃ māro upasaṅkamati, neva labhetha māro otāraṃ na labhetha māro ārammaṇaṃ;
segments.cnd23:274.10: manato cepi naṃ māro upasaṅkamati neva labhetha māro otāraṃ na labhetha māro ārammaṇaṃ.
segments.cnd23:275.1: “Evaṃvihārī cāvuso, bhikkhu rūpe adhibhosi [abhibhaviṃsu (syā.), abhibhosi (ka.) passa saṃ. ni.4.243], na rūpā bhikkhuṃ adhibhaṃsu;
segments.cnd23:275.2: sadde bhikkhu adhibhosi, na saddā bhikkhuṃ adhibhaṃsu;
segments.cnd23:275.3: gandhe bhikkhu adhibhosi, na gandhā bhikkhuṃ adhibhaṃsu;
segments.cnd23:275.4: rase bhikkhu adhibhosi, na rasā bhikkhuṃ adhibhaṃsu;
segments.cnd23:275.5: phoṭṭhabbe bhikkhu adhibhosi, na phoṭṭhabbā bhikkhuṃ adhibhaṃsu;
segments.cnd23:275.6: dhamme bhikkhu adhibhosi, na dhammā bhikkhuṃ adhibhaṃsu.
segments.cnd23:275.7: Ayaṃ vuccatāvuso, bhikkhu rūpādhibhū saddādhibhū gandhādhibhū rasādhibhū phoṭṭhabbādhibhū dhammādhibhū adhibhū anadhibhūto [anabhibhūto kehi ci kilesehi (ka.) passa saṃ. ni.4.243].
segments.cnd23:275.8: Adhibhosi te pāpake akusale dhamme saṃkilesike ponobhavike sadare dukkhavipāke āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiye.
segments.cnd23:276.1: Apariḍayhamānoti rāgajena pariḷāhena apariḍayhamāno, dosajena pariḷāhena apariḍayhamāno, mohajena pariḷāhena apariḍayhamānoti –
segments.cnd23:279.1: Ohārayitvā gihibyañjanānīti gihibyañjanāni vuccanti kesā ca massū ca … pe …
segments.cnd23:279.3: Ohārayitvā gihibyañjanānīti gihibyañjanāni oropayitvā samoropayitvā nikkhipitvā paṭippassambhitvāti –
segments.cnd23:280.1: Sañchannapatto yathā pārichattakoti yathā so pārichattako koviḷāro bahalapattapalāso [sākhapattapalāso (ka.)] sandacchāyo [saṇḍacchāyo (syā.), santacchāyo (ka.) passa ma. ni.1.154], evameva so paccekasambuddho paripuṇṇapattacīvaradharoti –
segments.cnd23:281.1: Kāsāyavattho abhinikkhamitvāti so paccekasambuddho sabbaṃ gharāvāsapalibodhaṃ chinditvā puttadāraṃ palibodhaṃ chinditvā ñātipalibodhaṃ chinditvā mittāmaccapalibodhaṃ chinditvā sannidhipalibodhaṃ chinditvā kesamassuṃ ohāretvā [ohārayitvā (syā. ka.)] kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitvā akiñcanabhāvaṃ upagantvā eko carati viharati iriyati vatteti pāleti yapeti yāpetīti –
segments.cnd23:293.1: Rasesu gedhaṃ akaraṃ aloloti. Rasoti mūlaraso khandharaso tacaraso pattaraso puppharaso phalaraso, ambilaṃ madhuraṃ tittakaṃ kaṭukaṃ loṇikaṃ khārikaṃ lambikaṃ [lambilaṃ (syā. ka.) passa āyatanavibhaṅge] kasāvo sādu asādu sītaṃ uṇhaṃ. Te ambilaṃ labhitvā anambilaṃ pariyesanti, anambilaṃ labhitvā ambilaṃ pariyesanti; madhuraṃ labhitvā amadhuraṃ pariyesanti, amadhuraṃ labhitvā madhuraṃ pariyesanti; tittakaṃ labhitvā atittakaṃ pariyesanti, atittakaṃ labhitvā tittakaṃ pariyesanti; kaṭukaṃ labhitvā akuṭakaṃ pariyesanti, akuṭakaṃ labhitvā kaṭukaṃ pariyesanti; loṇikaṃ labhitvā aloṇikaṃ pariyesanti, aloṇikaṃ labhitvā loṇikaṃ pariyesanti; khārikaṃ labhitvā akhārikaṃ pariyesanti, akhārikaṃ labhitvā khārikaṃ pariyesanti; kasāvaṃ labhitvā akasāvaṃ pariyesanti, akasāvaṃ labhitvā kasāvaṃ pariyesanti; lambikaṃ labhitvā alambikaṃ pariyesanti, alambikaṃ labhitvā lambikaṃ pariyesanti; sāduṃ labhitvā asāduṃ pariyesanti, asāduṃ labhitvā sāduṃ pariyesanti; Manāpikesu rasesu rattā giddhā gathitā mucchitā ajjhosannā laggā laggitā palibuddhā. Sā rasataṇhā tassa paccekasambuddhassa pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā. yāvadeva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃsūparatiyā brahmacariyānuggahāya. Iti purāṇañca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi, navañca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi, yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro cā”ti. Yathā vaṇaṃ ālimpeyya yāvadeva āruhaṇatthāya [ropanatthāya (syā.)], yathā vā akkhaṃ abbhañjeyya yāvadeva bhārassa nittharaṇatthāya, yathā puttamaṃsaṃ āhāraṃ āhareyya yāvadeva kantārassa nittharaṇatthāya; yāvadeva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃsūparatiyā brahmacariyānuggahāya. Iti purāṇañca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi, navañca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi, yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro cā”ti. Rasataṇhāya ārato virato paṭivirato nikkhanto nissaṭo vippamutto visaññutto vimariyādikatena cetasā viharatīti – rasesu gedhaṃ akaraṃ. Sā loluppā taṇhā tassa paccekasambuddhassa pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
segments.cnd23:293.2: Anaññaposī sapadānacārīti anaññaposīti so paccekasambuddho attānaññeva poseti, na paranti. Anaññaposī sapadānacārīti so paccekasambuddho pubbaṇhasamayaṃ [pubbanhasamayaṃ (ka.)] nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisati rakkhiteneva kāyena rakkhitāya vācāya rakkhitena cittena upaṭṭhitāya satiyā saṃvutehi indriyehi. Okkhittacakkhu iriyāpathasampanno kulā kulaṃ anatikkamanto piṇḍāya caratīti – anaññaposī sapadānacārī.
segments.cnd23:293.3: Kule kule appaṭibaddhacittoti dvīhi kāraṇehi paṭibaddhacitto hoti – attānaṃ vā nīcaṃ ṭhapento paraṃ uccaṃ ṭhapento paṭibaddhacitto hoti, attānaṃ vā uccaṃ ṭhapento paraṃ nīcaṃ ṭhapento paṭibaddhacitto hoti. Kathaṃ attānaṃ nīcaṃ ṭhapento paraṃ uccaṃ ṭhapento paṭibaddhacitto hoti? “Tumhe me bahūpakārā, ahaṃ tumhe nissāya labhāmi cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ. Yampi me porāṇaṃ mātāpettikaṃ nāmagottaṃ tampi me antarahitaṃ tumhehi ahaṃ ñāyāmi – Evaṃ attānaṃ nīcaṃ ṭhapento paraṃ uccaṃ ṭhapento paṭibaddhacitto hoti. Kathaṃ attānaṃ uccaṃ ṭhapento paraṃ nīcaṃ ṭhapento paṭibaddhacitto hoti? “Ahaṃ tumhākaṃ bahūpakāro, tumhe maṃ āgamma buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gatā dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gatā saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gatā, pāṇātipātā paṭiviratā, adinnādānā paṭiviratā, kāmesumicchācārā paṭiviratā, musāvādā paṭiviratā, surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭiviratā, tumhākaṃ ahaṃ uddesaṃ demi paripucchaṃ demi uposathaṃ ācikkhāmi navakammaṃ adhiṭṭhāmi; atha ca pana tumhe maṃ ujjhitvā aññe sakkarotha garuṃ karotha mānetha pūjethā”ti. Evaṃ attānaṃ uccaṃ ṭhapento paraṃ nīcaṃ ṭhapento paṭibaddhacitto hoti.
segments.cnd23:293.4: Kule kule appaṭibaddhacittoti so paccekasambuddho kulapalibodhena appaṭibaddhacitto hoti, gaṇapalibodhena appaṭibaddhacitto hoti, āvāsapalibodhena appaṭibaddhacitto hoti, cīvarapalibodhena appaṭibaddhacitto hoti, piṇḍapātapalibodhena appaṭibaddhacitto hoti, senāsanapalibodhena appaṭibaddhacitto hoti, gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārapalibodhena appaṭibaddhacitto hotīti – kule kule appaṭibaddhacitto, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. Tenāha so paccekasambuddho –
segments.cnd23:298.4: eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. Pahāya pañcāvaraṇāni cetasoti so paccekasambuddho kāmacchandanīvaraṇaṃ pahāya pajahitvā vinodetvā byantīkaritvā anabhāvaṃ gametvā, byāpādanīvaraṇaṃ … thinamiddhanīvaraṇaṃ … uddhaccakukkuccanīvaraṇaṃ … vicikicchānīvaraṇaṃ pahāya pajahitvā vinodetvā byantīkaritvā anabhāvaṃ gametvā vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharatīti – pahāya pañcāvaraṇāni cetaso. segments.cnd23:300.1: Vipiṭṭhikatvāna sukhaṃ dukhañca, pubbeva ca somanassadomanassanti so paccekasambuddho sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharatīti –
segments.cnd23:300.2: vipiṭṭhikatvāna sukhaṃ dukhañca, pubbeva ca somanassadomanassaṃ.
segments.cnd23:301.2: Upekkhāti yā catutthajjhāne upekkhā upekkhanā ajjhupekkhanā cittasamatā cittappassaddhatā [cittavisaṭatā (ka.) passa mahāni.207] majjhattatā cittassa.
segments.cnd23:301.3: Samathoti yā cittassa ṭhiti saṇṭhiti avaṭṭhiti avisāhāro [avisaṃhāro (ka.) passa dha. sa.11,15] avikkhepo avisāhaṭamānasatā [avisaṃhaṭamānasatā (ka.)] samatho samādhindriyaṃ samādhibalaṃ sammāsamādhi;
segments.cnd23:301.4: catutthajjhāne upekkhā ca samatho ca suddhā honti visuddhā pariyodātā anaṅgaṇā vigatūpakkilesā mudubhūtā kammaniyā ṭhitā āneñjappattā.
segments.cnd23:301.5: Laddhānupekkhaṃ samathaṃ visuddhanti catutthajjhānaṃ upekkhañca samathañca laddhā labhitvā vinditvā paṭilabhitvāti –
segments.cnd23:301.6: laddhānupekkhaṃ samathaṃ visuddhaṃ, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.
segments.cnd23:304.2: Yo so sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ.
segments.cnd23:304.3: Paramatthassa pattiyā lābhāya paṭilābhāya adhigamāya phassanāya sacchikiriyāya āraddhavīriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ sampadāya thāmavā [thāmasā (ka.)] daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesūti –
segments.cnd23:305.1: Alīnacitto akusītavuttīti so paccekasambuddho anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati, uppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya … pe …
segments.cnd23:305.3: uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā [bhāvanāpāripūriyā (syā.)] chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahatīti –
segments.cnd23:306.1: Atha vā,“kāmaṃ taco ca nhāru ca aṭṭhi ca avasissatu [avasussatu (syā.) ma. ni.2.184; saṃ. ni.2.22 passitabbaṃ], sarīre upasussatu maṃsalohitaṃ, yaṃ taṃ purisathāmena purisabalena purisavīriyena purisaparakkamena pattabbaṃ na taṃ apāpuṇitvā vīriyassa saṇṭhānaṃ [viriyassa ṭhānaṃ (syā.)] bhavissatī”ti cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
segments.cnd23:309.1: “Na tāvāhaṃ imaṃ pallaṅkaṃ bhindissāmi yāva me na anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccissatī”ti cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
segments.cnd23:310.1: “Na tāvāhaṃ imamhā āsanā vuṭṭhahissāmi yāva me na anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccissatī”ti cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
segments.cnd23:311.15: rukkhamūlā nikkhamissāmi yāva me na anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccissatī”ti cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
segments.cnd23:312.1: “Imasmiṃyeva pubbaṇhasamaye [pubbaṇhasamayaṃ (ka.) mahāni.17] ariyadhammaṃ āharissāmi samāharissāmi adhigacchissāmi phassayissāmi sacchikarissāmī”ti cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
segments.cnd23:312.17: pacchime vayokhandhe ariyadhammaṃ āharissāmi samāharissāmi adhigacchissāmi phassayissāmi sacchikarissāmīti cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
segments.cnd23:313.1: Daḷhanikkamo thāmabalūpapannoti so paccekasambuddho daḷhasamādāno ahosi kusalesu dhammesu avaṭṭhitasamādāno kāyasucarite vacīsucarite manosucarite dānasaṃvibhāge sīlasamādāne uposathupavāse matteyyatāya [metteyyatāya (syā. ka.) moggallānabyākaraṇe 4.39 suttaṃ oloketabbaṃ] petteyyatāya sāmaññatāya brahmaññatāya kulejeṭṭhāpacāyitāya aññataraññataresu adhikusalesu dhammesūti –
segments.cnd23:313.3: Thāmabalūpapannoti so paccekasambuddho thāmena ca balena ca vīriyena ca parakkamena ca paññāya ca upeto hoti samupeto upāgato samupāgato upapanno samupapanno samannāgatoti –
segments.cnd23:316.1: Paṭisallānaṃ jhānamariñcamānoti so paccekasambuddho paṭisallānārāmo hoti paṭisallānarato ajjhattaṃ cetosamathamanuyutto anirākatajjhāno vipassanāya samannāgato brūhetā suññāgāraṃ jhāyī jhānarato ekattamanuyutto sadatthagarukoti paṭisallānaṃ.
segments.cnd23:316.2: Jhānamariñcamānoti so paccekasambuddho dvīhi kāraṇehi jhānaṃ na riñcati –
segments.cnd23:316.3: anuppannassa vā paṭhamassa jhānassa uppādāya yutto payutto saṃyutto āyutto samāyutto, anuppannassa vā dutiyassa jhānassa … pe …
segments.cnd23:316.5: anuppannassa vā catutthassa jhānassa uppādāya yutto payutto saṃyutto āyutto samāyuttoti –
segments.cnd23:317.1: Atha vā, uppannaṃ vā paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti, uppannaṃ vā dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ … pe …
segments.cnd23:317.3: uppannaṃ vā catutthaṃ jhānaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.
segments.cnd23:318.1: Dhammesu niccaṃ anudhammacārīti dhammā vuccanti cattāro satipaṭṭhānā … pe …
segments.cnd23:318.4: Sammāpaṭipadā apaccanīkapaṭipadā anvatthapaṭipadā dhammānudhammapaṭipadā sīlesu paripūrakāritā indriyesu guttadvāratā bhojane mattaññutā jāgariyānuyogo satisampajaññaṃ –
segments.cnd23:318.6: Dhammesu niccaṃ anudhammacārīti dhammesu niccakālaṃ dhuvakālaṃ satataṃ samitaṃ avokiṇṇaṃ poṅkhānupoṅkhaṃ udakūmikajātaṃ [udakummijātaṃ (syā.), udakummikajātaṃ (ka.)]
segments.cnd23:319.1: Avīcisantatisahitaṃ phassitaṃ purebhattaṃ pacchābhattaṃ purimayāmaṃ majjhimayāmaṃ pacchimayāmaṃ kāḷe juṇhe vasse hemante gimhe purime vayokhandhe majjhime vayokhandhe pacchime vayokhandhe carati viharati iriyati vatteti pāleti yapeti yāpetīti –
segments.cnd23:320.1: Ādīnavaṃ sammasitā bhavesūti “sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā”ti ādīnavaṃ sammasitā bhavesu,
segments.cnd23:320.4: “yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ, sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman”ti ādīnavaṃ sammasitā bhavesūti –
segments.cnd23:320.5: ādīnavaṃ sammasitā bhavesu, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.
segments.cnd23:323.3: Taṇhakkhayanti rāgakkhayaṃ dosakkhayaṃ mohakkhayaṃ gatikkhayaṃ upapattikkhayaṃ paṭisandhikkhayaṃ bhavakkhayaṃ saṃsārakkhayaṃ vaṭṭakkhayaṃ patthayanto icchanto sādiyanto pihayanto abhijappantoti –
segments.cnd23:323.5: Appamattoti so paccekasambuddho sakkaccakārī sātaccakārī … pe … appamādo kusalesu dhammesūti –
segments.cnd23:324.2: Aneḷamūgoti so paccekasambuddho paṇḍito paññavā buddhimā ñāṇī vibhāvī medhāvī.
segments.cnd23:324.3: Sutavāti so paccekasambuddho bahussuto hoti sutadharo sutasanniccayo.
segments.cnd23:324.4: Ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhekalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti, tathārūpāssa dhammā bahussutā honti dhātā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā.
segments.cnd23:324.5: Satīmāti so paccekasambuddho satimā hoti paramena satinepakkena samannāgatattā cirakatampi cirabhāsitampi saritā anussaritāti –

segments.cnd23:325.4: “yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman”ti saṅkhātadhammo ñātadhammo tulitadhammo tīritadhammo vibhūtadhammo vibhāvitadhammo.
segments.cnd23:325.5: Atha vā, tassa paccekasambuddhassa ca khandhā saṃkhittā dhātuyo saṃkhittā āyatanāni saṃkhittāni gatiyo saṃkhittā upapattiyo saṃkhittā paṭisandhiyo saṃkhittā bhavā saṃkhittā saṃsārā saṃkhittā vaṭṭā saṃkhittā.

segments.cnd23:327.4: Niyāmaṃ patto sampatto adhigato phassito sacchikato patto niyāmaṃ.
segments.cnd23:327.6: So cetaso vīriyārambho nikkamo parakkamo uyyāmo vāyāmo ussāho ussoḷhī thāmo dhiti asithilaparakkamo anikkhittacchandatā anikkhittadhuratā dhurasampaggāho vīriyaṃ vīriyindriyaṃ vīriyabalaṃ sammāvāyāmo.

segments.cnd23:330.1: Sīhova saddesu asantasantoti yathā sīho migarājā saddesu asantāsī aparisantāsī anutrāsī anubbiggo anussaṅkī [anussukī (syā.)] anutrāso abhīrū acchambhī anutrāsī apalāyī, paccekasambuddhopi saddesu asantāsī aparisantāsī anutrāsī anubbiggo anussaṅkī anutrāso abhīrū acchambhī anutrāsī apalāyī pahīnabhayabheravo vigatalomahaṃso viharatīti –

segments.cnd23:331.4: Yathā vāto jālamhi na sajjati na gaṇhāti na bajjhati na palibajjhati, evameva dve jālā –
segments.cnd23:331.8: Tassa paccekasambuddhassa taṇhājālaṃ pahīnaṃ diṭṭhijālaṃ paṭinissaṭṭhaṃ, taṇhājālassa pahīnattā diṭṭhijālassa paṭinissaṭṭhattā so paccekasambuddho rūpe na sajjati sadde na sajjati … pe …

segments.cnd23:332.3: Yathā padumapupphaṃ toyena na limpati na palimpati na upalimpati, alittaṃ apalittaṃ anupalittaṃ, evameva dve lepā –
segments.cnd23:332.7: Tassa paccekasambuddhassa taṇhālepo pahīno, diṭṭhilepo paṭinissaṭṭho.
segments.cnd23:332.8: Taṇhālepassa pahīnattā diṭṭhilepassa paṭinisaṭṭhattā so paccekasambuddho rūpe na limpati sadde na limpati … pe …

segments.cnd23:335.1: Sīho yathā dāṭhabalī pasayha, rājā migānaṃ abhibhuyya cārīti yathā sīho migarājā dāṭhabalī dāṭhāvudho sabbe tiracchānagate pāṇe abhibhuyya abhibhavitvā ajjhottharitvā pariyādiyitvā madditvā carati viharati iriyati vatteti pāleti yapeti yāpeti, paccekasambuddhopi paññābalī paññāvudho sabbapāṇabhūte puggale paññāya abhibhuyya abhibhavitvā ajjhottharitvā pariyādiyitvā madditvā carati viharati iriyati vatteti pāleti yapeti yāpetīti –
segments.cnd23:335.2: sīho yathā dāṭhabalī pasayha, rājā migānaṃ abhibhuyya cārī.
segments.cnd23:336.1: Sevetha pantāni senāsanānīti yathā sīho migarājā araññavanamajjhogāhetvā carati viharati iriyati vatteti pāleti yapeti yāpeti, paccekasambuddhopi araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevati appasaddāni appanigghosāni vijanavātāni manussarāhasseyyakāni paṭisallānasāruppāni.

segments.cnd23:336.3: sevetha pantāni senāsanāni, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.
